integrity: The proof separates every subcode support into a fixed simplex-block contribution and the coordinate support of its message subspace. Inclusion-exclusion then counts all full-support message subspaces. A standalone verifier exhaustively checks all subspaces for four small binary and ternary instances.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the binary Theorem 3.1(i) and ternary Theorem 3.7 systematic simplex LCD families. It does not claim novelty for the classical generalized Hamming weights of the simplex block itself and does not extend automatically to the article's other constructions.
title: Exact higher-support spectra for the new systematic simplex LCD families
